text:
incident_bot: :loud_sound: Alert: spike in kv_cache.seq_mismatch and unusual token overlap reports. Severity auto-classified as SEV-2. Traces showing cross-request token contamination for workflows using long-prefix caching.

alicia (oncall): acked. Paging @jamie and @priya. Any correlation with the batching changes promoted last night?

jamie (eng-runtime): looking. Yes, 01:40 UTC deploy introduced "continuous_batching_v2" and a new page recycling path. I can see increased `kv.page_reuse` rates starting 01:42 and a cluster of seq_mismatch logs from runtime nodes in eu-west-1. Example sanitized log:
```
[01:58:03] runtime ERROR kv: page_read pid=0x3e4a seq_expected=2048 seq_actual=1024 request_id=R-abc123
[01:58:03] runtime WARN serve: token_stream mismatch origin=R-ff7b -> R-abc123
```
This indicates reused pages with stale seq pointers.

priya (eng-ml): support saw customer notes saying responses contain fragments from earlier sessions when context length > 8k. Could be severe for privacy-sensitive customers.

sam (sre): suggest immediate containment: 1) disable continuous_batching_v2 flag 2) enforce strict seq checks at read-time 3) schedule rolling pod restarts for nodes with page_age > 300s. I can execute restarts.

jamie (eng-runtime): agreed. I'm going to flip the runtime feature flag to off for prod-edge first, then prod. Command we use: `ffctl set continuous_batching_v2 --env=prod-edge --value=false`

rico (support): I'll assemble the affected-customer list and start proactive outreach. Which customers are likely hit?

jamie (eng-runtime): I pulled logs and matched requests with `context_len>6000` and `kv.hit_rate>0.75`. Suspected: LedgerBank, Chatly, Formify. Rico, please prioritize LedgerBank for P1 outreach.

incident_bot: Action: feature_flag_change by jamie at 2190001302.

jamie (eng-runtime): flag disabled on prod-edge at 2190001302. Monitoring shows seq_mismatch drop in that cluster. I'll push disable to prod in 5m.

alicia (oncall): go for prod, but reduce rollout speed to allow canaries. Leave one AZ pinned for rollback.

jamie (eng-runtime): disabling now on prod: `ffctl set continuous_batching_v2 --env=prod --value=false --rate=20%`

priya (eng-ml): also add a runtime assertion to fail loud when seq_actual != seq_expected by more than a page size. We want noisy failures in canary so we catch any silent leaks.

jamie (eng-runtime): adding `--kv-strict-seq-check=true` to canary via k8s patch:
```
kubectl -n runtime patch deployment runtime --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"KV_STRICT_SEQ_CHECK","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```
Patch applied to canary at 2190001420.

sam (sre): triggering restarts for pods with high page_age. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n runtime --field-selector='metadata.name=runtime-*-old'` (I ran targeted restarts for runtime-eu-1a, runtime-eu-1b at 2190001455).

incident_bot: Restart job started for pods [runtime-eu-1a, runtime-eu-1b] at 2190001455.

rico (support): LedgerBank notified at 2190001480. They acknowledged and requested timeline + mitigation steps. I've escalated to their security team and assigned account SE.

jamie (eng-runtime): after disabling the flag and patching canary, seq_mismatch metrics dropped ~93% in canary and no noisy assertions fired. Rolling disable to 50% then 100% now. Rollout events: 2190001502 -> 2190001550 -> complete at 2190001588.

priya (eng-ml): running replay harness across 2k customer sessions including LedgerBank's anonymized prompts — no cross-request contamination observed post-mitigation.

sam (sre): note: we still have some pods with page objects created pre-mitigation. I finished targeted restarts; page_age now within normal thresholds.

incident_bot: Hotfix branch created: gh://redwood/inference/bugfix/kv-seq-guard-219. CI passing as of 2190001605.

jamie (eng-runtime): hotfix work: 1) stamp pages with origin_epoch and last_request_id, 2) zero seq pointers before reuse, 3) add seq normalization logic when merging pages from different requests. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3498 (hotfix branch). Will run canary rollout with `KV_STRICT_SEQ_CHECK=true` and `KV_REUSE_SAFE=true` after tests.

priya (eng-ml): add unit + fuzz tests that simulate offset wrap and interleaved requests. I added new test vectors to eval suite.

rico (support): customers LedgerBank and Chatly received follow-ups with technical summary and offer for logs. No data exfil confirmed so far. Formify reported intermittent duplicated phrases but no PII exposure.

alicia (oncall): current status: mitigated (continuous_batching_v2 disabled, strict checks enabled, targeted restarts done). Impact: correctness restored; estimated compute delta +6% while strict checks are enabled.

jamie (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix to prod at 2190001702; monitoring for seq_mismatch and token overlap reports.

incident_bot: Deploy event: hotfix rollout start 2190001702 target=prod strategy=canary->gradual.

jamie (eng-runtime): hotfix promoted to prod at 2190001765. Post-deploy: no seq_mismatch logs, kv.page_reuse resumed under new safe codepath.

priya (eng-ml): full regression replay complete at 2190001800 — zero contamination. Adding a permanent regression test in CI gating.

sam (sre): runbook updates: add `page_age` metric alert, emergency toggle for `continuous_batching_v2`, and automated recycle when page_age > 180s. Filed runbook PR: https://internal.redwood/runs/rvb-543.

rico (support): final customer notes dispatched. LedgerBank requested postmortem; SE assigned to coordinate.

alicia (oncall): handoff: jamie to own technical postmortem, priy a owns ML regression artifacts, rico owns customer follow-ups, sam to update runbook. I'll close pager in 1h if metrics remain stable.

incident_bot: Severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 2190001880. Follow-up reminders set for 72h.

alicia (oncall): thanks all. Please add logs and timelines to the postmortem doc and link the PRs. :thanks:
